title: init (referee to bot)
description: First message of a game, sent before version negotiation. Carries no v; its format is stable across all protocol versions and only gains new fields.

supported.description: Protocol versions the referee accepts; the bot picks one in ready.

increment_ms.description: Time added after each own move.

startup_ms.description: Budget for process start and on_game_start, separate from the thinking time; ready must arrive within it.

memory_limit_mib.description: Fixed memory protection limit of the sandbox (A14), for information only, e.g. to size a hash table.
